items.title: Derek Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: I played with everybody — Frank Sinatra.

ctx.x: Well I played the hell out of it. And I listed that on my resume — played with Pavarotti. But I mean all those guys over the years, I played with everybody — Frank Sinatra. Frank was between conductors and he’s had a pianist with him, a guy called Bill Miller, forever. They’re buddies all their lives. Well, he didn’t like the conductor so they elevated Bill Miller to be the conductor, and they said well we need a pianist, so get Derek in for this weekend. So I came down to Atlantic City to play, and so Frank is…
No kidding. You mean the orchestra transposed it?
